name: Scholomance
shortDescription: Scholomance, a Classic-era setting in the Ras Frostwhisper research story.
body: This location appears in the Classic quest sequence. The existing Classic Scholomance illustration uses cold slate-blue necromantic stone, tombs, shelves and restrained green alchemical light. Its room composition is interpretive, not a dungeon map. The scene is interpretive; the story-tour marker and theater staging assert no exact geographic coordinates.
